_comment: Fishing baits (spec 11.2), used up one per cast. bite = multiplier on the wait for a bite (smaller = faster). luck adds to the rod's luck. attracts: species picked twice as often with this bait. only_tag: the bait attracts only fish with that tag. night_only: refused by day. buy: Ngư Ông sells it for this many Linh Thạch each. craft: Ngư Ông turns `from` x1 into `makes` baits. Fishing with no bait at all is allowed, but slower and only Phàm/Linh fish bite (balance/fishing.json no_bait).

moi_muc.desc_vi: Mực Tinh vê thành viên. Chỉ cá Mực cắn, và chỉ khi trời tối.
